description: Profile a source extract against a target schema: per-column type and null profile, unmapped columns, absent target fields, and a go/no-go readiness verdict. Before a data migration or a bulk load, to find the blockers and the weak columns. Do not choose this when you need the data transformed or loaded, which needs the systems. Example requests: Is this data ready for migration to my target schema? | Profile this extract and tell me what blocks the migration. | Which columns are unmapped or mostly empty before a data migration? | Run a data migration readiness check on this CSV and target schema.

accepted_price.description: The amount accepted, exactly as quoted (for example "5.00" or 5). Checked against the stored quote, so a price that moved between quote and authorize is refused rather than silently absorbed. Optional, but sent to make the acceptance explicit.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

source_csv.description: The customer's source.csv, as text. Supported: CSV with a header row. The source extract. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

target_schema.description: The customer's target_schema.txt, as text. Supported: Text. The target fields, one per line. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

quote_id.description: The quote_id returned by POST /v1/jobs. Required to authorize a priced capability; the service rejects a priced job that does not name the quote it issued.

name: submit_data_migration_readiness_pack

access_token.description: Per-job credential. Present it as the X-Job-Token header to read the job or list it. Keep it; it is the only credential for this job.

verification.description: Independent verification. verification.ok = false means the job failed, not a partial success.

title: Data migration readiness pack
